column4: cleat#2043: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect, and mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestWorkerRestartServesARecordedSecretOnlyRefusalWithoutReinvokingLive -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two, and 0 failures. Proves a second worker replaying a recorded secret-only refusal from LoadEventHistory never re-invokes the plugin live with the literal -- postgres running here still exercises the mechanism, the other two dialects just aren't reachable in this job.

same dialect gating as the cluster job's line in test-a-worker-restart-serves-a-recorded-secret-only-refusal-without-reinvoking-live.tsv, but a SEPARATE job key: `Test Go (engine) on 1.26` also runs `go test -p 1 ./engine/...` against PostgreSQL only (CLEAT_TEST_DB, ci.yml's test-go matrix entry "engine"), so it independently owes these same two dialect skips. The ledger is keyed per job, so one line does not cover both invocations. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestWorkerRestartServesARecordedSecretOnlyRefusalWithoutReinvokingLive -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two.
